request: Owner, 7 Nov: «по иконкам сделай редизайн… сделай их чуть более концептуальными, чем они сейчас… сохраняй нотки реализма».
model: gpt_image_2_6 (Higgsfield), quality high, 1k, transparent background; objects 4:3, small icons 1:1
promptTemplate: Semi-conceptual object icon, halfway between a premium product photograph and a refined 3D app icon: [concept]. Slightly simplified, idealized forms with softly rounded edges and fewer, cleaner details than a photograph, while keeping real material cues: [materials]. Soft even studio light from the upper left, gentle ambient occlusion, a small soft contact shadow directly under the object. Warm palette of cream, sand, terracotta red, deep sage green and brushed brass. Three-quarter view from slightly above, centred. Fully transparent background with crisp clean silhouette edges: no glow, no halo, no white rim, no backdrop. No text, letters, numbers, logos, emblems, flags, people or hands. (Small icons add: a bold simple silhouette that stays readable at 24 pixels.)
position: Between the 6 Nov studio objects (guides) and the conceptual cabinet stage icons (stages/*, unchanged): real materials, simplified forms, and an idea carried by the composition (a balance scale for ISEE, speech bubbles over a book for translation, two seals for parental consent, a magnifier on the diploma for recognition).
processing: Trimmed, fitted (contain) into the exact old frames so no layout moves: objects 480xH (H unchanged per name) with 6px air, WebP q84/alpha92 at 480 and 240; small icons 128x128 with 4px air, WebP q88/alpha95. Reviewed on #FFFDF9 and at 24/32px: no text, numerals, emblems, flags or people; light semi-transparent edge pixels at most 316 (calendar), no halo.
